# Authored video fixture

This two-second black 160×96 H.264 video and 440 Hz AAC tone were generated for Coconut tests with scripts/create_authored_mp4.py and official PyAV 16.1.0. It contains no third-party footage, speech, or transcript. It is only browser/container test evidence, never a live-platform or ASR success claim.

The 16,653-byte MP4 is committed so ordinary browser tests need no Python dependencies or media generation.
